gaps.title: Is learning-from-novel-material (and teaching, calibration, multi-turn communication) actually off the general factor? Quantitative test plus the missing counter-evidence

Lifecycle of synthetic long-context and in-context-learning benchmarks (NIAH, RULER, NoLiMa, HELMET, MRCR, Graphwalks, Michelangelo, LOFT, LongBench v2, Fiction.LiveBench, AA-LCR, LongICLBench, many-shot ICL)
Validity of LLM-simulated students and users as the instrument, and a human-learning external criterion for teaching-gain metrics
Do the survey's success and failure factors hold for uncovered families: instruction following, function calling, honesty/safety, domain (medical, legal, finance), multilingual and multimodal?
